releaseStatus: Automated and observed browser checks passed
summary: GoalKeeper 0.2.0 passed 161 automated tests in 15 files, type checking and production build. Observed browser checks passed at 1440×900. Native compilation passed with 0 tests; native desktop runtime remains unqualified. Tested implementation: 6bc0a0821e74.

checks.name: Automated software checks
checks.detail: 161 tests / 15 files; TypeScript checks; production build. Final npm run verify log retained. Vitest 5.0.3.

checks.name: Browser GSN geometry
checks.detail: 16 charts, 144 nodes and 1,314 text lines; 0 text outside shapes. Complete text retained at 16px, including long tokens and identifiers.

checks.name: Observed browser workflows
checks.detail: At 1440×900, canvas uses 100% workspace width. Pan/drag, saved branch restore, theme reload, pop-up focus, evidence navigation and validation were observed. Keyboard menu launch and Escape focus return passed; 0 browser errors.

checks.name: Native compilation
checks.detail: cargo test --offline compiled GoalKeeper 0.2.0 successfully; library, binary and doc harnesses contained 0 tests. This is not native UI qualification.

checks.name: Dependency/build notices
checks.detail: 13 npm packages; 10 source archives; 11 embedded notices; 9 ELK file hashes; 39 distribution files. npm audit: 0 known vulnerabilities at the recorded run.

checks.name: Native desktop runtime
checks.detail: Native picker, physical-vault reopen, application restart and actual desktop interaction were not qualified. Mocked adapter coverage is identified separately.

checks.name: SVG delivery through browser
checks.detail: Serializer tests and reopened renderer SVG figures pass. In-app-browser download completion was not observable; no successful download is asserted.

checks.name: Runtime privacy observation
checks.detail: Offline/source boundary reviewed. Network observation was unavailable through the browser-control API; no measured no-transmission result is claimed.

limitations: GSN v3 core Part 1 §2 profile only; pattern, modular, Assurance Claim Point and dialectic extensions are not implemented.
The alternate SysML/KerML-style projection is illustrative, read-only and not parser-verified language interchange.
The FireSat argument is an illustrative draft. Operational control effectiveness, accepted residual exposure and authority approval are not established.
Native desktop runtime qualification is distinct from browser and pure-core tests; unexecuted procedures are not reported as passed.
Local file replacement does not provide a transaction across all Markdown files; a future SSTPA adapter must retain host authorization and commit validation.
Browser SVG-download completion and runtime network activity were not observable through the available browser-control interface; these are explicit qualification gaps.
